svg.title: Yiban core database review model
svg.desc: 14 tables, 23 foreign keys. Derived from active CREATE TABLE statements. Source revision working-tree. Draft; not a complete product schema and not database execution evidence.
svg.text: DRAFT | 14 tables / 23 foreign keys | source working-tree
Green: implemented accounts. Blue: proposed core + planned extensions (moderation / reading). user.status/disabled_* are planned (M2), not in 0001.
Links: referenced table to referencing table. 1 : 0..N = one parent, zero or more child rows.
? = nullable. U = UNSIGNED. U* = participates in a composite unique key. See SQL for full definitions.
